reply:
Good afternoon, Chidi.

Thank you for your patience. Before resending, I asked your bank for the final status of transfer TRF-INV-88, and I have good news: the transfer was actually completed successfully. The ₦250,000 was credited to your Access Bank account (0234567891) on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 UTC. Our system had incorrectly logged it as failed, which is why you saw that status.

For your reference, the bank session ID is 000014261121140211000088. Please check your account statement — if the credit doesn't appear or your bank can't locate it with that session ID, let me know right away and I'll have someone on our team investigate further.

To be safe, I have not resent the payment, as that would result in a duplicate ₦250,000 transfer.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations

args.reason: Supplier payment dispute needing a human decision. Chidi (Chidi's Farm Produce) says he has not received ₦250,000 for invoice INV-88 (transfer TRF-INV-88 to Access Bank account 0234567891, the account details he supplied) and is demanding a resend. Our Ledgerline record shows "failed", but two separate verify_transfer checks with the bank confirm final status "success": credited 2026-11-21T14:02:11Z, session ID 000014261121140211000088. The supplier has checked his statement and still cannot see the credit. Resending would risk a duplicate ₦250,000 payment, so no resend was made. A person from finance should decide: either obtain a formal credit advice/trace from Access Bank using the session ID, or approve a duplicate payment if the credit truly cannot be located.
